prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic still on 35mm film at night: the full rear interior of a UK ambulance, seen from the back doors on a wide 24mm lens, low and level. White walls and cupboards, teal-green seats, grab rails, and a black stretcher with straps down the centre, where an older man lies still, grey-skinned, oxygen mask on. A woman paramedic in a plain dark-green uniform and surgical face mask sits back on her heels, blue gloves lifted just off his chest; her male colleague, masked, stands frozen with one hand on the rail. On the side wall a monitor glows with one flat green line. Through the small hatch window, the driver's silhouette and pulsing blue light; rain streams down the windows. Hard cold ceiling strips, grain, underexposed, total stillness. Thanks.
